test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 16 Mar 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Beating the Retreat was organised by the defense forces at the Vijay Chowk.

options.text: The Vijay Chowk organised Beating the Retreat at the defense forces.
The defense forces were organising Beating the Retreat at the Vijay Chowk.
Beating the Retreat was organising the defense forces at the Vijay Chowk.
The defense forces organised Beating the Retreat at the Vijay Chowk.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The defense forces organised Beating the Retreat at the Vijay Chowk**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are a few things to keep in mind when converting from passive to active voice.
 
• The structure of active voice is:** Subject + verb + object.**
 
• In an active voice, the subject performs the action(verb) on the object.
 
• The **agent**(who does the action) in the passive voice becomes the **subject **in the active voice.
 
• In the correct sentence, "**the defense forces**" are the subject followed by the verb **organised **and the object is **"beating the retreat"**.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**
